Change se->load.weight to se_weight(se) in the calculation for the
initial util_avg to avoid unnecessarily inflating the util_avg by 1024
The reason is that se->load.weight has the unit/scale as the scaled-up

column2: while cfs_rg->avg.load_avg has the unit/scale as the true task

column1: weight (as mapped directly from the task's nice/priority value). With

column2: the scaled-up load is equal to the true task weight. With
the scaled-up load is 1024 times the true task weight.
the current code may inflate the util_avg by 1024 times. The

column1: follow-up capping will not allow the util_avg value to go wild. But the
calculation should have the correct logic.
